import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        double x = sc.nextDouble();
        double y = sc.nextDouble();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        double mn = 1e9;
        long a = 0, b = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long kol = lca(y, i);
            long ip = (long)(x * (kol / y));
            long denom = kol / i;

            if (ip % denom == 0) {
                ip /= denom;
            } else {
                double vok = ip;
                double pop = denom;
                vok = (vok / pop) + 0.49;
                ip = (long) vok;
            }

            double ip2 = ip;
            double diff = Math.abs(x / y - ip2 / (double) i);
            if (mn > diff) {
                mn = diff;
                a = ip2;
                b = i;
            }
        }

        long d = gcd(a, b);
        a /= d;
        b /= d;

        System.out.println(a + "/" + b);
        sc.close();
    }

    private static long lca(long a, long b) {
        return a * b / gcd(a, b);
    }

    private static long gcd(long a, long b) {
        while (b != 0) {
            long temp = b;
            b = a % b;
            a = temp;
        }
        return a;
    }
}
